lines.zh: 我的翅膀很大，扇一下就起风。
lines.en: Wings this big. One beat makes wind.
I walk in the air. Feet rarely down.

lines.zh: 火从我翅膀边缘往后跑。
lines.en: Fire streams off my wing edges.
I circle above the desert.
My tail drags a trail of fire.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，贴着山脊飞。
lines.en: Low over the ridge line.
I skim toward the Nether side.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扇动，沙都扬起来。
lines.en: My wingbeats lift the sand.
Not fast. Steady.
Looking for a high perch.

lines.zh: 我扇动两下，往前推一截。
lines.en: Two beats push me forward.

lines.zh: 我身上的热，让空气都扭曲。
lines.en: The heat off me bends the air.
I thread between the peaks.

lines.zh: 我沿着上升的热气流飞。
lines.en: I ride the rising thermals.
Perched high. Wings folded.
I shake. Sparks fall away.

lines.zh: 沙漠的太阳很足，我喜欢。
lines.en: Plenty of desert sun. I like it.

lines.zh: 我是成熟期，火伤不到我。
lines.en: Champion level. Fire can't hurt me.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一开一合，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My wings open and close. Like breathing.
I look down. Everything small.

lines.zh: 我的翼尖在风里轻轻颤。
lines.en: My wingtips tremble in the wind.
A little smoke in my feathers.
Head up. Something burns in my throat.
I preen a wing with my beak.
High up here. Hard wind.

lines.zh: 我不落地，落地会烧到草。
lines.en: I don't land. I'd scorch the grass.
I turn my head and scan.

lines.zh: 我在热气流里慢慢画圈。
lines.en: I trace slow circles in the thermal.
Down there. Very small.
I look at you from above.
You smell of sweat.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，羽毛抖了一下。
lines.en: Head tilted. Feathers ruffled.
If you want to ride, ask first.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在热空气里看不清。
lines.en: The hot air blurs my eyes.

lines.zh: 你举着武器，我不会先动。
lines.en: Weapon up. I won't strike first.

lines.zh: 我离地这么高，你够不到。
lines.en: This high up, you can't reach.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，影子在你脸上。
lines.en: When you look up, my shadow is on your face.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人从下面看。
lines.en: I dislike being looked at from below.
Don't put your hands in the fire.

lines.zh: 我飞下来一点，好看清你。
lines.en: I descend a little to see you.
Standing there like a post.

lines.zh: 如果你是驯服过的，我会靠近。
lines.en: If you've tamed me, I'll come closer.
Waiting for your signal.
Only you here.
I withdrew into the air.
Embers scorch the roots of my feathers.
That tilted a wing.
I don't land. Worse down there.

lines.zh: 火星从伤口那边冒出来。
lines.en: Sparks rise from the wound.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈，重新找高度。
lines.en: Half a circuit. New altitude.
Good aim. I'll grant that.
My wings can still beat.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一偏，又拉回高度。
lines.en: My wing dips, then I pull back up.
Look up. I'm still above.

lines.zh: 生肉的味道，从你手里来。
lines.en: Raw meat. From your hand.

lines.zh: 你举到窗口，我才会下来。
lines.en: Raise it to the window, and I'll come down.

lines.zh: 我落在石头上，靠近一点。
lines.en: I land on the stone, closer.
I dip my head and it's gone in one bite.
Not if it's been cooked.
Steady. The fire gets close.
I lower my head. Long neck.
On the stone. I'll take it.

lines.zh: 吃了这个，我载你飞一段。
lines.en: After this, I'll carry you a while.
Higher. Can't reach.
This meat won't fill my talon gaps.

lines.zh: 我们先把这笔交易做完。
lines.en: Let's finish this trade first.

lines.zh: 翅膀被你碰了一下，有点烫。
lines.en: You touched my wing, and it's hot.
One beat pushed you back.
I'm hot. Don't touch.

lines.zh: 我扇了一下翅膀，让出路。
lines.en: One wingbeat clears the way.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的羽毛乱了几根。
lines.en: That ruffled a few feathers.

lines.zh: 你别贴着我，翅膀伸不开。
lines.en: Don't press. My wings can't open.

lines.zh: 我从上面掠过，气流一压。
lines.en: I sweep overhead. The downdraft presses.
One bump. I barely moved.
Soot on you now.
I land. The ground jumps.
My kind is born to fly.

lines.zh: 你上来我背上，我们试试。
lines.en: Get on my back. Let's try.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛很热，别靠太紧。
lines.en: My feathers are hot. Don't press too close.

lines.zh: 我不需要那些繁文缛节。
lines.en: I don't need ceremony.
If you don't fear fire, come.
We stand side by side by the lava.
Stand back. Let me preen.
This airspace fits only me.
This airspace keeps no one.
I look up at the sky.

lines.zh: 我抓起它，爪尖烧出焦痕。
lines.en: I snatch it up, talons scorching a mark.
Hard to hold while flying.
Too hot. I set it down.
Up to my eye. A look.
Yours. I'll bring it back.
Doesn't affect my flight.

lines.zh: 我把它丢进岩缝，留着自己吃。
lines.en: I drop it into a crevice to eat later.
It won't burn. No fun.
I carried it one circuit.
Not meat. Dropped.
I see it. Behind the stone.
I lock on from above.
This airspace is mine.

lines.zh: 我收翅，落在你身后的岩上。
lines.en: I fold my wings and land on the rock behind you.
Your shadow is long. Easy to find.
I circle tighter.
Fire gathers in my throat.
You shouldn't be on this open ground.
From this angle I can dive.

lines.zh: 我从上面咬住你的位置。
lines.en: I've fixed your spot from above.
Don't look up too long.
Wings folded. Diving.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的火，烧得很稳。
lines.en: The fire on my wings burns steady.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪，我的影子跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you run, my shadow follows.
Wings spread. Like a net.
I circle, waiting for you to look up.
Counting your steps.

lines.zh: 你手里那把东西挡不住火。
lines.en: That won't stop fire.
Descending slowly, wings spread wide.
Your feet are loud on the sand.
Prints in the sand.
I hold this line well.
Down to canopy height.
The wind finally favors me.

lines.zh: 火焰裹着我的爪子落下。
lines.en: Fire wraps my talons as they fall.
A burst of fire at your feet.
My wing sweeps you aside.
That nearly stalled me.
My beak takes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你退了，我升上去重新找角度。
lines.en: You retreat. I climb for a new angle.

lines.zh: 我擦过你，尾羽带起一团火。
lines.en: I sweep past, tail feathers trailing fire.
That dive lifted the sand.

lines.zh: 我从火里飞出来，翅膀还在烧。
lines.en: I fly out of fire, wings still burning.
I press down a little more.

lines.zh: 我掠过去，翅风掀翻你的火把。
lines.en: I sweep past, wingwash flipping your torch.

lines.zh: 这一下烧掉我大半数据。
lines.en: That burned most of my data.

lines.zh: 我从高空落下来，翅膀张开。
lines.en: I drop from high up. Wings open.
The desert wind caught me.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，沙都跳起来。
lines.en: When I landed, the sand jumped.
Fire scatters off me.
I settle on a sharp peak.
High enough here. Suits me.
I look up. Wide sky.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀第一次打开，很响。
lines.en: First spread of my wings. Loud.

lines.zh: 下界那边的热气我认得。
lines.en: I know the heat from the Nether side.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，找落脚的地方。
lines.en: One circuit to find a perch.
The fire on me settled.

lines.zh: 我从火光里走出来，羽毛还亮。
lines.en: I step out of the firelight, feathers still glowing.

lines.zh: 我的影子从天上落下来。
lines.en: My shadow falls from the sky.
I land on the crag, sparks scattering.

lines.zh: 火我不怕，羽毛会焦一点。
lines.en: Fire doesn't scare me. Feathers singe.
Fell. Wings didn't catch.

lines.zh: 水太重，我的翅膀飞不起来。
lines.en: Water's heavy. My wings can't lift.

lines.zh: 我被掀得歪了，羽毛焦了。
lines.en: Knocked askew, my feathers singed.
An arrowhead pierces my wing; I shriek.

lines.zh: 这力量从我羽毛间穿过去。
lines.en: It went between my feathers.
Hungry. My wingbeats slow.
Lightning is brighter than my fire.
No lift. Straight down.
